# TopAITools.ai Robots.txt
# Crawler policy:
# - Public search and AI-answer crawlers are allowed on all public, content-rich pages.
# - Training-only crawlers (GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot) are blocked to protect content rights.
# - IMPORTANT: This robots.txt is advisory only. Also enforce at CDN/WAF/firewall for security-sensitive routes.
# - Sitemaps are generated via scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs from LIVE API data.

Sitemap: https://www.topaitools.ai/sitemap.xml
